title: Cartan--Eilenberg resolution properties for a bounded-below complex
statement: Let $\mathcal B$ be an abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with enough injectives, let $K^\bullet$ be a bounded-below complex, and let $C^{\bullet,\bullet}$ be a Cartan--Eilenberg resolution in the convention of [thm-sp-if-e1], with the two indices exchanged (Stacks Project's $I^{p,q}$ is $C^{q,p}$). Thus, for every $q$, the row $(C^{\bullet,q},d_I)$ is an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of $K^q$; for every $p$, the column $(C^{p,\bullet},d_{II})$, whose differential is induced by that of $K^\bullet$, has injective cycle, boundary, and cohomology objects. Consequently, for every left exact additive functor $G$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], $H^q_{II}(G(C^{p,\bullet}))=G(H^q_{II}(C^{p,\bullet}))$. For every $q$, the complex $(H^q_{II}(C^{p,\bullet}))_p$ with differential induced by $d_I$ is an injective resolution of $H^q(K^\bullet).
